description: This file defines the 'Tax' class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It manages tax calculations, including setting addresses for shipping, payment, and store, and computing applicable tax rates based on different rules and configurations.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: Class responsible for managing tax rules, calculations, and associated address settings within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Tax object with database and configuration references from the registry.

methods.name: setShippingAddress
methods.description: Sets the tax rules based on a provided shipping address (country and zone).

methods.name: setPaymentAddress
methods.description: Sets the tax rules based on a provided payment address.

methods.name: setStoreAddress
methods.description: Sets the tax rules based on the store's address.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates the total amount including applicable taxes for a given value and tax class.

methods.name: getTax
methods.description: Returns the total tax amount for a specified value and tax class.

methods.name: getRateName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a specific tax rate by its ID.

methods.name: getRates
methods.description: Retrieves applicable tax rates and their calculated amounts based on value and tax class.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all stored tax rate data in the object.
